So target molecule is "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1". Need to apply template 1914397 to this molecule, get precursors list.

We have tool apply_template. Use it with molecule_smiles and template_id.
